summary: Version-control the observability stack config (grafana + influxdb)
Fix unreadable live-summary stat panel (panel-12)
Fix blank Pressure panel (panel-7) on tempest-basic
Add Backups dashboard + InfluxDB backup heartbeats + R2 upload pipeline
backups dashboard: add Obsidian vault target (3 stat panels)
Expand Tempest dashboard to all metrics; group into rows + sensor filter
Audit transit-tracker dashboards; fix nonexistent-metric queries
Add campsite availability ingestion: datasource + dashboard
Add Mac host system metrics: Telegraf + mac-system dashboard (#2)
Cloudflare collector-history dashboard (exploration) (#3)
Add Mountain Out dashboards + R2→InfluxDB ingest (mountain bucket) (#4)
Campsite collector + live-availability dashboards (Analytics Engine) (#5)
Convert campsite AE dashboards to vertamedia query format + AE dialect fixes
Multi-series panels: AE-native pivot (per-agency) + table (hot dates)
Collector History: add 'Latest capture' panel (#7)
mac-system: btop-style whole-system process treemap (echarts) (#8)
Walksheds uptime collector + Grafana dashboard (#10)
ha-system: Telegraf system dashboard for homeassistant.local (#12)
transit-tracker-monitor: add Realtime Coverage row (live vs scheduled) (#18)
Add OrbStack/Docker container monitoring (#13)
ha-pi-system: dashboard for HA Raspberry Pi host metrics (HA System Monitor) (#24)
ha-pi-system: fix CPU temp unit (°F); retire dead Telegraf-on-HA artifacts (#25)
claude-usage: token-usage dashboard + transcript collector (#26)
obsidian-backups: build the per-vault backup dashboard (#32)
obsidian-backups: clean per-vault series labels (#33)
grafana: add dashboard data-provenance (source:) + retire mountain (#39)
dashboards: campsite availability metrics + collector throughput & R2 storage (#42)
organize dashboards into domain folders; drop campsite-availability (duplicate)
campsite-availability-metrics: default target_date to today+future (was opening on earliest/past date with no trend data)
campsite-collector-history: make AE panels follow the time picker ($timeSeries/$timeFilter) instead of hardcoded now()-30d windows — fixes nodata on short ranges

campsites: fix pre-existing query bugs surfaced by the new tests — collector fleet-coverage/sites_2d used AE-unsupported uniqExactIf (now count(DISTINCT)); availability Booked% Flux reduce() used 'acc' not 'accumulator'
campsites: merge campsite-availability-metrics + campsite-live-availability into campsite-availability (live AE 'right now' section + Influx per-night history section)

transit-tracker-basic: fix 'Next →' stat panels erroring with Flux 'type conflict: float != int' (int arrival_time_s * 1000.0) by coercing float(v:); surfaced by the new repo-wide integration nodata suite (#67)
transit-alerts: new dashboard for OBA service_alert data (#23) — active-alert count, alert-points by reason, over-time band, per-alert state-timeline, and a latest-summary/affects table

transit-station-availability: new dashboard for per-station trip_prediction availability (#16) — stations reporting, predictions/station over time, live-vs-scheduled split, coverage table, per-station freshness
collector-freshness: new ops dashboard — points/min per continuously-written bucket (transit_tracker/home_assistant/tempest_archive); the panels the collector-freshness alerts screenshot into Discord
campsite-collector-history: add Health & quarantine row — failure ratio %, inactive-sites stat, currently-inactive DLQ table, and inactive/reactivated state-changes table (AE)
alerts-anomalies: new ops dashboard — built-in alertlist + window z-score anomaly view off the new ops.anomaly event stream (anomaly-detector)
orbstack-containers: add btop-style memory treemap (tile area = mem used, colour = % of mem_limit) — the OOM-risk-at-a-glance view
claude-usage: add 'Cache tokens' Shown/Hidden toggle variable — hides cache_creation/cache_read series in the hourly timeseries (cache-read dwarfs real tokens ~100x)
campsite-availability: per-site drill-down — cascading Loop/Site dropdowns + per-site availability table off the new site_availability measurement; relabel+cascade the campground dropdown off agency
campsite-availability: wire agency/campground filters into the live AE section (panels 3-7) — were system-wide, now respect the dropdowns
campsite-demand: new dashboard — most in-demand sites/campgrounds, hottest nights, campground×night booking heatmap; off new pre-aggregated site_demand/campground_demand summaries (ingest.py)

campsite-predictions: new dashboard — prediction-readiness gauge (events·coverage·depth)^(1/3) + component bargauge, band, history, an expected-accuracy boundary timeseries, a live stat row (campgrounds, collection days, cells, expected accuracy), and an explainer text panel (model, targets, references); fed by a predict_readiness measurement (incl. expected_accuracy, campgrounds, collect_days) the daily campsites ingest now emits from the R2 sites/ history (mirrors rgs predict/readiness.py + PREDICT.md §2 accuracy curve)
